# Buntal JS: complete reference for AI agents

> Buntal JS is an ultra-lightweight, type-safe full-stack framework for Bun and React with Next.js-like file-system routing. This file is the whole API in one place. Versions: buntal 0.2, @buntal/http 0.0.15, @buntal/cli 0.0.12. Requires Bun >= 1.2.

## Ground rules

- Buntal is NOT Next.js. Never import from `next/*`. There is no App Router, no server components, no `"use client"`, no `getServerSideProps`, no `generateMetadata`. Use the APIs below only.
- Runtime is Bun. Prefer Bun built-ins: `bun:sqlite`, `Bun.password`, `Bun.file`, `Bun.write`, `bun test`.
- TypeScript everywhere. `.tsx` for pages and layouts, `.ts` for API routes.

## Packages

| Package | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `buntal` | React framework: pages, layouts, `Link`, `Meta`, `Script`, `Svg`, `useRouter`, `BuntalConfig` |
| `@buntal/http` | HTTP server: `Http`, `h`, `Req`, `Res`, `Cookie` |
| `@buntal/http/middlewares` | `auth`, `jwt`, `cors`, `logger`, `secureHeaders` |
| `@buntal/cli` | `buntal dev`, `buntal build`, `buntal start` |
| `create-buntal` | `bun create buntal@latest my-app` |

## Full-stack project

```sh
bun create buntal@latest my-app
cd my-app
bun dev                      # http://localhost:3000 (PORT env overrides)
bun run build && bun start   # production
```

Structure:

```
app/
  layout.tsx        root layout: renders <html>, <head>, <body>
  index.tsx         page for /
  globals.css       Tailwind CSS v4 entry (compiled to /globals.css)
  favicon.svg
  about/index.tsx   page for /about
  posts/[id]/index.tsx          dynamic segment -> params.id
  docs/[[...slug]]/index.tsx    optional catch-all -> params.slug ("a/b")
  api/hello/index.ts            API route for /api/hello
  404.tsx           optional custom not-found page
public/             static files served as-is (dotfiles are not served, except .well-known/)
buntal.config.ts    optional config
```

Rules:

- A page is `app/<route>/index.tsx` with a default export. Folders starting with `_` are ignored.
- `layout.tsx` wraps every page in its folder and below. A folder's layout only renders when that folder has a page.
- The `@/` import alias maps to the project root (see tsconfig).
- Import text files with `import Logo from '@/app/logo.svg' with { type: 'text' }`.

### Root layout

```tsx
import { Meta, type MetaProps } from 'buntal'

export default function RootLayout({
  children,
  data
}: Readonly<{ children: React.ReactNode; data?: { _meta?: MetaProps } }>) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <Meta title="My App" description="Built with Buntal" {...data?._meta} />
        <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" />
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="/globals.css" />
      </head>
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

### Pages and props

```tsx
export default function Page({
  params,
  query,
  data
}: {
  params: Record<string, string>
  query: Record<string, string>
  data?: unknown
}) {
  return <h1>Hello {query.name ?? 'there'}</h1>
}
```

### `$`: server data loader

Export `$` from a page or layout. It runs on the server for the initial render and is re-fetched as JSON on client navigation. The page receives the return value as `data`. `data._meta` sets SEO tags (merged with layout `_meta`, page wins).

```tsx
import type { Req } from '@buntal/http'
import type { MetaProps } from 'buntal'

export const $ = async (req: Req) => {
  const post = await getPost(req.params.id)
  if (!post) return { notFound: true }
  return { post, _meta: { title: post.title, description: post.excerpt } satisfies MetaProps }
}

export default function PostPage({ data }: { data?: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof $>> }) {
  if (!data || 'notFound' in data) return <p>Not found</p>
  return <article>{data.post.title}</article>
}
```

- Static data: `export const $ = { _meta: { title: 'About' } }` (an object, not a function) is inlined at build time.
- Return a `Response` to stop rendering, e.g. a redirect: `return Response.redirect('/login', 302)` or `new Response(null, { status: 302, headers: { location: '/login' } })`. Works on full loads and client navigation.
- Loader responses are sent with `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. In production, thrown errors return a generic 500 without details.
- Validate `req.params` before touching the filesystem. Resolve paths and check they stay inside your content folder.

### API routes inside a full-stack app

```ts
// app/api/todos/index.ts
import { h } from '@buntal/http'

export const GET = h((req, res) => res.json({ todos: [] }))

export const POST = h(async (req, res) => {
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => null)) as { title?: unknown } | null
  if (!body || typeof body.title !== 'string' || !body.title.trim()) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'title is required' })
  }
  return res.status(201).json({ title: body.title.trim() })
})
```

Exports named GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD are dispatched. HEAD falls back to GET. Any other method gets 404.

### buntal.config.ts

```ts
import { auth, secureHeaders } from '@buntal/http/middlewares'
import type { BuntalConfig } from 'buntal'

export default {
  appDir: './app',          // default
  outDir: '.buntal',        // default; must stay inside the project
  staticDir: './public',    // default
  config: {},               // extra Bun.build options for the client bundle
  serverOptions: {},        // passed to Bun.serve
  middlewares: [secureHeaders()]
} satisfies BuntalConfig
```

`middlewares` run before every page, `$` loader and API route. Static files and bundles are served before middlewares, so a login page still gets its JS and CSS. A global `auth()` therefore protects all pages; for public pages, protect per route instead (see Security).

Environment: only variables named `BUNTAL_PUBLIC_*` are inlined into the browser bundle. Everything else stays on the server.

### Components and hooks (from `buntal`)

- `<Link href="/about">`: client-side navigation for same-origin links. External, `mailto:`, modifier-clicks, `target="_blank"` and `download` behave like a normal `<a>`. `href="#id"` smooth-scrolls (`#id:120` uses a 120px offset). `href="-1"` goes back.
- `<Meta title description keywords author viewport og={{...}} twitter={{...}} />`: head tags.
- `<Script src="..." async onLoad={...} />`: load a script after hydration.
- `<Svg src={svgString} className="..." />`: inline SVG; sanitized (scripts, event handlers, foreignObject, javascript: URLs removed). Pass `unsafe` only for trusted markup.
- `useRouter()` returns `{ pathname, search, hash, href, hostname, protocol, push(url), replace(url), back(), reload() }`. Read `params` and `query` from page props, not from the hook.

## @buntal/http (APIs without React)

```ts
import { Http } from '@buntal/http'
import { cors, logger, secureHeaders } from '@buntal/http/middlewares'

const app = new Http({ port: 4000, appDir: './app' })   // appDir optional: file routes

app.use(logger())
app.use(secureHeaders())
app.use(cors({ origin: ['https://app.example.com'] }))

app.get('/hello/:name', (req, res) => res.json({ hello: req.params.name }))  // params are typed
app.post('/items', handler)
app.put(path, ...handlers); app.patch(...); app.delete(...); app.options(...)
app.route('GET', '/x', ...handlers)   // same as app.get
// GET and POST on the same path are both kept.

app.onNotFound((req, res) => res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not found' }))
app.onError((error) => Response.json({ error: 'Oops' }, { status: 500 }))

app.start((server) => console.log(`http://localhost:${server.port}`))
```

File routes with `appDir`: `app/ping.ts` -> `/ping`, `app/users/[id].ts` or `app/users/[id]/index.ts` -> `/users/:id`.

### h and AtomicHandler

`type AtomicHandler<P, T> = (req: Req<P, T>, res: Res) => Response | void | Promise<Response | void>`

`h(...handlers)` runs handlers in order; the first one to return a `Response` wins. Returning nothing passes control to the next handler. If none returns, the result is 204. Middlewares are just AtomicHandlers.

```ts
export const GET = h<{ id: string }, { userId: string }>(
  (req, res) => {
    if (!req.headers.get('x-api-key')) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' })
    req.context = { userId: 'u_1' }
  },
  (req, res) => res.json({ id: req.params.id, by: req.context?.userId })
)
```

### Req (extends the Web `Request`)

- `req.params`: route params. `req.query`: query string as an object. `req.cookies`: parsed cookies.
- `req.context`: typed slot for data shared between handlers (set by `auth()` to the decoded token).
- Standard Request API: `req.method`, `req.url`, `req.headers.get()`, `await req.json()`, `await req.formData()`, `await req.text()`.

### Res (builder, chainable)

- `res.status(201)`, `res.headers({ 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' })`
- Terminal methods return a `Response`: `res.json(data)`, `res.text(str)`, `res.html(str)`, `res.send(body)`, `res.redirect(url, 302)`
- `res.cookie(name, value, options)` sets a cookie; `res.cookie(name, null, { path })` deletes it. Multiple cookies are all sent.
- Headers and cookies set on `res` by middlewares are also applied when a handler returns its own `new Response(...)`.

### Cookies

`CookieOptions = { maxAge?: number; expires?: Date; path?: string; domain?: string; secure?: boolean; httpOnly?: boolean; sameSite?: 'Strict' | 'Lax' | 'None' }`

- Invalid names, or `path`/`domain` containing `;` or spaces, throw a TypeError.
- `sameSite: 'None'` always adds `Secure`. `maxAge: 0` expires the cookie.
- Session cookie recommendation: `{ httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: 'Lax', path: '/', maxAge: 60 * 60 * 2 }`.

## Middlewares (`@buntal/http/middlewares`)

### auth and jwt

```ts
import { auth, jwt } from '@buntal/http/middlewares'

const tokens = jwt(process.env.JWT_SECRET!)        // throws if the secret is empty
const token = await tokens.sign({ sub: user.id }, { expiresIn: '2h' })   // HS256
const payload = await tokens.verify<{ sub: string }>(token)

app.get('/me', auth<{ sub: string }>({ secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET! }), (req, res) =>
  res.json({ id: req.context?.sub })
)
```

Options: `secret` (required, non-empty), `strategy: 'header' | 'cookie' | 'both' | Strategy[]` (default `'header'`), `cookie: { key }` (default `access_token`), `header: { key }` (default `Authorization`, `Bearer` prefix optional, case-insensitive), `onVerified(req, res, decoded)` (return a Response to reject). Missing or invalid tokens get 401. OPTIONS preflight requests pass through.

### cors

`cors({ origin = '*', methods, allowedHeaders, exposedHeaders, maxAge = 600, credentials = true })`

- `origin` as an array is an allow list: the matching request origin is echoed with `Vary: Origin`, others get no CORS headers.
- `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` is only sent for allow-listed origins, never with `*`.
- Answers OPTIONS preflight with 204. Register `cors()` before `auth()`.

### secureHeaders

`secureHeaders({ contentSecurityPolicy = false, frameOptions = 'SAMEORIGIN', hsts = 'max-age=15552000; includeSubDomains', referrerPolicy = 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin', permissionsPolicy = 'camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()' })`

Always sets `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`. HSTS is only sent over https (or `x-forwarded-proto: https`). Pass `false` to disable any header.

### logger

`logger()` prints `[HH:MM:SS] > METHOD /path`.

## Recipes

### Protect only some pages

```tsx
// app/dashboard/index.tsx
import type { Req } from '@buntal/http'
import { jwt } from '@buntal/http/middlewares'

export const $ = async (req: Req) => {
  const token = req.cookies.access_token
  const user = token
    ? await jwt(process.env.JWT_SECRET!).verify<{ sub: string }>(token).catch(() => null)
    : null
  if (!user) return Response.redirect(new URL('/login', req.url), 302)
  return { userId: user.sub }
}
```

### Login API with sqlite and Bun.password

```ts
// app/api/login/index.ts
import { h } from '@buntal/http'
import { jwt } from '@buntal/http/middlewares'
import { Database } from 'bun:sqlite'

const db = new Database('data/app.db')

export const POST = h(async (req, res) => {
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => null)) as { email?: string; password?: string } | null
  const user = body?.email
    ? db.query<{ id: string; hash: string }, [string]>('select id, hash from users where email = ?').get(body.email)
    : null
  if (!user || !body?.password || !(await Bun.password.verify(body.password, user.hash))) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid credentials' })
  }
  const token = await jwt(process.env.JWT_SECRET!).sign({ sub: user.id })
  return res
    .cookie('access_token', token, { httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: 'Lax', path: '/', maxAge: 7200 })
    .json({ ok: true })
})
```

### Safe content loading for catch-all routes

```ts
import path from 'path'

const ROOT = path.resolve('content/docs')
const file = path.resolve(ROOT, `${req.params.slug || 'index'}.mdx`)
if (!file.startsWith(ROOT + path.sep) || !(await Bun.file(file).exists())) {
  return { notFound: true }
}
```

### Testing an API

```ts
import { expect, test } from 'bun:test'
import { Http } from '@buntal/http'

test('GET /ping', async () => {
  const app = new Http({ port: 0 })
  app.get('/ping', (_, res) => res.json({ pong: 1 }))
  const server = app.start()
  const resp = await fetch(`http://localhost:${server.port}/ping`)
  expect(await resp.json()).toEqual({ pong: 1 })
  server.stop(true)
})
```

## Best practices

Full page: https://buntaljs.org/docs/best-practice

Structure and data
- Keep `app/` for routes; put data access and validation in `lib/`, shared UI in `components/`, page-only components in `app/**/_components/` (folders starting with `_` are not rendered as pages).
- Load page data in `$`, querying the database directly. Use a static `$` object for request-independent pages. Run independent queries with `Promise.all`.

SEO (every page is server-rendered, so crawlers see full HTML)
- Root layout: `<html lang="en">` and one `<Meta>` with site defaults (`og.site_name`, `twitter.card`), spread with `data?._meta`.
- Each page's `$` returns `_meta` with a unique `title` (50-60 chars), `description` (<= 155 chars), and absolute `og.url` / `og.image` (1200x630).
- Canonical URL: render `<link rel="canonical" href="https://your.site/path" />` in the page; React 19 hoists it into `<head>`. Build it from your public origin, not `req.url`.
- Structured data: `<script type="application/ld+json" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(obj).replace(/</g, '\u003c') }} />` (Organization, WebSite, Article, Product, BreadcrumbList).
- Sitemap: `app/sitemap.xml/index.ts` exporting GET that returns `application/xml` built from your data. RSS: `app/rss.xml/index.ts` with `application/rss+xml`.
- `public/robots.txt` with `Sitemap: https://your.site/sitemap.xml`; disallow admin/account paths.
- Unknown URLs render `app/404.tsx` with status 404. When `$` finds no record the page renders with status 200, so render `<meta name="robots" content="noindex" />` in that branch, and on admin, cart, account and search pages.
- One `<h1>` per page, ordered headings, descriptive link text, `alt` on meaningful images, readable URLs (`/products/blue-mug`). Use `<Link>` for internal links (real `<a href>`, crawlable).

Performance
- Routes are code-split; keep heavy libraries inside the pages that use them.
- Loader responses are `private, no-store`; cache shared expensive data in memory in `lib/`. Put a CDN in front of static files and the bundle; bump `package.json` version per release (it versions `/root.js`).
- Images with `width`/`height`, `loading="lazy"` below the fold, modern formats. Fonts preconnected with `display=swap` or self-hosted.

Accessibility
- Semantic landmarks, labels on every input, visible focus, keyboard support, 4.5:1 contrast, `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Errors, testing, deployment
- Consistent API errors `{ error, details? }` with correct status codes; `logger()` plus an error tracker.
- `bun test` (server on port 0), `bunx tsc --noEmit` in CI, check `bun run build && bun start` before release.
- Deploy with `bun start` behind a TLS proxy that sets `x-forwarded-proto`; secrets via env vars; SQLite on a persistent volume; add `app/api/health/index.ts`.

## Common mistakes

- Importing from `next/link` or `next/router`: use `Link` and `useRouter` from `buntal`.
- Fetching your own API from `$`: query the database directly inside `$` instead.
- Setting `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` with credentials: use `cors({ origin: [...] })`.
- Reading secrets in components: components also run in the browser. Keep secrets in `$` and API routes.
- Putting `auth()` in `buntal.config.ts` middlewares when the site has public pages: protect per route.
- Returning `{ notFound: true }` from `$` without a `noindex` meta tag: search engines index the empty page as a soft 404.
- Using `req.url` for canonical or Open Graph URLs: behind a proxy it can be an internal host. Use your public origin.
